items.text: Cancer has struck millions of American families, including mine. Having access to intensive early detection, individuals are able to address and treat cancer earlier on. I have signed on to H.R. 4110 as this bill provides those with inherited mutation access to early treatment. https://t.co/oBJRMUp1aW

Lymphedema is a chronic condition that causes swelling, pain, and decreased mobility in legs and arms—common side effects of cancer treatment.

I cosponsored H.R. 3630 to reduce the financial burden of treatment, so that lymphedema patients have access to the care they need. https://t.co/UPx4NJTqsg

Today I joined my good friend and colleague @RepCarbajal in passing HR 2499, a bipartisan bill that guarantees eligibility for federal firefighters who have been exposed to toxic fumes and substances while on duty. This ensures they get the treatment they need. https://t.co/BEz0WgHyxS

Last week, @RepCarbajal and I passed H.R. 2499, the Federal Firefighters Fairness Act. Creating the presumption that federal firefighters who become disabled by serious diseases while on duty, ensures they receive treatment and benefits that would normally not be covered. https://t.co/Jv47r1Mpd7
